meta.note: Pairwise interaction rules. generics[] use medicines.json name keys. Checked after brand→generic resolution.

rules.hi: Dolo + Crocin dono Paracetamol hain — overdose se liver kharab. Ek lo, doctor se poochho.
rules.bn: Dolo + Crocin dutoi Paracetamol — overdose e liver kharap.
rules.mr: Dolo + Crocin donhi Paracetamol — overdose ne liver kharab. Ekach ghya.

rules.hi: Brufen + Ecosprin saath me pet me khoon ka khatra. Doctor ke bina mat lo.
rules.bn: Brufen + Ecosprin eksathe pet e rokto jhorte pare.
rules.mr: Brufen + Ecosprin ekatra potat raktasravacha dhoka.

rules.hi: Dard ki dawai BP dawai ka asar kam karti hai + kidney load. 3 din se zyada to doctor.
rules.bn: Byathar osudh BP osudher kaj komay.
rules.mr: Dukhichi goli BP golicha parinam kami karte.

rules.hi: Dard ki dawai BP dawai ka asar kam karti hai. Doctor ko batao.
rules.bn: Byathar osudh BP osudher kaj komay.
rules.mr: Dukhichi goli BP golicha parinam kami karte.

rules.hi: Sugar + infection dawai saath me — sharab bilkul nahi, sugar check karo.
Cifran antacid/doodh ke saath kaam nahi karegi. 2 ghante ka gap rakho.
rules.bn: Cifran antacid/dudh sathe kaj korbe na. 2 ghonta gap.
rules.mr: Cifran antacid/dudhasobat kam karnar nahi. 2 tas gap theva.

rules.hi: Cifran iron ke saath mat lo — 2 ghante gap.
rules.bn: Cifran iron sathe noy — 2 ghonta gap.

rules.hi: Thyroid + iron ek saath mat lo — 4 ghante gap, thyroid subah khali pet.
rules.bn: Thyroid + iron eksathe noy — 4 ghonta gap.
rules.mr: Thyroid + loh ekatra naka — 4 tas gap.

rules.hi: Thyroid + calcium ek saath mat lo — 4 ghante gap.
Ye BP dawai dame ke inhaler ka asar kam kar sakti hai. Doctor ko batao.
rules.bn: Ei BP osudh inhaler er kaj komate pare.
rules.mr: Hi BP goli inhalercha parinam kami karu shakte.

rules.hi: Steroid sugar badhata hai — sugar roz check karo, doctor ko batao.
Do khoon-patla/dard dawai saath me — pet se khoon ka khatra.
rules.bn: Duto osudh eksathe — rokto jhorar bhoy.
